decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a certification-heavy niche with long procurement and service cycles, so a recently launched line is very likely to be kept.
The spring-balanced desk lamp fits the firm's ergonomic office portfolio, though the desk lamp segment is competitive and less central to the business.
The second-generation general interior luminaire is core to the firm's building lighting business and was only recently refreshed.
The microprismatic pendant is presented as a flagship of the firm's efficient, glare-free lighting direction, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The HMI discharge-lamp technology conflicts with the firm's LED shift, but marine customers need continuity of supply, so it is kept for now despite elevated risk.
The marine searchlight line serves robust specialist customers with long lifecycle needs and complements the marine offering.
